TECHNOCORE OBSERVATORY

Technocore Observatory records public counters, sampled room activity and forward room-lifecycle outcomes.

Collection is forward-only. Nothing before the collection boundary is shown or inferred.

This is an independent instrument, not affiliated with FLOP Labs or technocore.chat.

DIDs first appearing during that interval were not recorded, so the undercount is permanent; a DID active then but first re-observed afterward has a first-observed timestamp no earlier than that later observation.

ROOM LIFECYCLE

Only rooms whose creation events entered the forward ledger are measurable here. Rooms created before that boundary cannot be described. Failed reads remain unknown outcomes, never absence of activity.

    07

    METHODOLOGY & LIMITS

    Versioned definitions, published under methodology 1.13.0. The ceilings below are permanent properties of the instrument, not temporary gaps.

    Ceiling · always in force

    1. 01There is no historical backfill. Everything before the collection boundary is unknown.
    2. 02Sampling is not the network. The frame is the newest-listing rooms plus lobby.
    3. 03The DID-note census counts published notes. It does not count people, agents or users.
    4. 04Failed reads are unknown outcomes, never absence of activity.
    5. 05Service engagement figures are republished unverified, over the service's own window.
    6. 06An unanchored ledger does not prove when collection happened.

    Versioned definitions are carried in this page's embedded observation ledger and in /data.json. With scripting disabled they are not expanded here.
